_comment: Which of condor's agents bench sizes a model for, and which it does not.
condor separates agents from strategies by storage, not by a field: a strategy is
created *under* an agent (create_strategy(slug, ...) writes into strategy.dir) and
inherits that agent's identity. Everything in condor's agents/ directory is an
agent by that definition. But the roster has grown to include entries that are
really specialisations of another agent -- an XRPL market maker is a market maker
pointed at one connector -- and giving each its own routing domain would multiply
recommendations every time a user ships one, on evidence that is the base
specialist's evidence under a different name.
condor does not encode this distinction (created_by does not correlate: two
experts carry a user id, two carry 0, one carries none), so bench records it here.
role: expert   -> gets a routing domain and a CONDOR_CONFIG_KEYS entry
role: strategy -> no routing domain; evidence comes from Layer 2 tool competence
Every agent condor ships must appear here. An unclassified agent fails
tests/test_matrix_routing.py::test_every_shipped_agent_has_a_routing_domain
on purpose: the decision should be made deliberately once, not defaulted
silently in either direction. If condor ever adds a role field to AGENT.md,
read it there and keep this file only for overrides.
Tool counts are NOT recorded in these notes. They were, and they rotted: the
prose argued from '8 tools' and 'inherits all 24' while the grants had grown to
16-20 against a 44-tool surface, so the subset arguments below were being read
against numbers that no longer held. Read the current grant from the agent's own
AGENT.md `tools:` list (bench/client.load_agent_tools does exactly that) and the
surface from datasets/tool_surface.json. What belongs here is the *reasoning* —
which base an agent specialises and why — since that is the judgement a count
cannot make for you.

adaptive_grid_trader.notes: Grid trading, but the loop is directional: multi-timeframe analysis picks LONG/SHORT/TWO_SIDED and re-picks it as conditions move, so the grid is the execution shape rather than the job. Based on directional_trader over market_making_expert on grants too: its grant is a subset of the directional base (which declares tools: [] and inherits the whole surface), while market making misses several of its tools — trading_agent_journal_write and send_notification among them — and adds manage_bots and manage_controllers, which this agent is not granted.

condor.notes: The chat assistant. Full surface, and the only domain whose name differs from its slug.

dca_accumulator.notes: Laddered spot accumulation via dca_executor — level spacing, per-level size, budget, and re-laddering after a move. Directional rather than market-making: it is one-sided accumulation with a long bias, explicitly not grids or two-sided quoting. Grants agree with the job on the same reasoning as adaptive_grid_trader. Note this one is a *local* agent (.condor/agents/), not part of the roster condor ships, and its grant still names pre-d5eab53e tools (get_market_data, manage_executors) — so it is not evidence about the current surface.

directional_trader.notes: Declares tools: [] so it inherits the whole surface. Base for directional strategies.

fundamental_analyst.notes: Fundamental analysis of companies and DeFi protocols — revenue, expenses, yield, risk, comps, valuation. Declares tools: [] (server_required: false); the job is research via run_code / the web, not the trading surface, so it is its own domain rather than a specialisation of directional_trader.

market_making_expert.notes: Scoped to a subset of the surface, centred on the bot/controller pair (manage_bots + manage_controllers) that no other expert is granted. Base for connector-specific market-making strategies.

meteora_launch_lp.notes: Scoped, and holds the only exclusive grant in the roster (manage_amm), so no other domain's evidence covers its core tool.

smart_money_flow.notes: Directional perp trading on Derive. Scoped to a subset of the directional base, on the same reasoning as adaptive_grid_trader.

solana_dex_lp_expert.notes: Scoped, and the only agent granted the orphaned-position pair (list_orphaned_positions + resolve_orphaned_position). Base for chain- or venue-specific LP strategies.

xrpl_market_maker.notes: Market making specialised to the XRPL CLOB connector. Note the grant does not nest: it holds tools its market-making base is not granted (create_order_executor, stop_executor, send_notification), so the inherited model assignment rests on domain evidence rather than on a subset argument.
